caseNameFull: STEPHEN C. McCANDLESS v. United States
disposition: The judgment is reversed in part, and tbe Supreme Court examines and determines every item.
syllabus:
On the defendants’ Appeal.

The case presents a number of items in a clerk’s account for his fees of office.

The court below renders judgment in favor of the claimant without an opinion, this being one of many oases where the construction of the statutes by the Supreme Court is desired.

opinions.author: Brown
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Brown

delivered tbe opinion of tbe Supreme Court, March 6, 1893.
